record.question: Who has been awarded with the Israel's 2018 Genesis Prize?
record.explanation: Answer D: Natalie Portman. Natalie Portman was selected as the 2018 Genesis Prize laureate. The Foundation’s original November 2017 announcement names her. By April 2018 she declined to attend and the June ceremony was cancelled, but the Foundation continued to identify her as the 2018 laureate. Historical/source note: Selected 2018 laureate; she did not attend a completed June 2018 award ceremony, which was cancelled following her April decision. Reference: https://www.genesisprize.org/press-center/2017-11-05-academy-award-winning-actress-natalie-portman-selected-as-the-18-genesis-prize-laureate; https://www.genesisprize.org/press-center/2018-04-19-natalie-portman-cancels-visit-to-jerusalem-to-receive-the-jewish-nobel. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical facts are anchored to the original exam; no matching examiner key is asserted.
